sections.text:
[Effects]
Reduces physical and magic damage taken by L+.
Increases status ailment resistance by XXL.
Reduces physical Ability Power by 4XL+.
Reduces magic Ability Power by 4XL+.
Damage reduction scales with the number of Light elemental Helm/Hat/Armor/Clothing type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of XXL (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 3).

[Activation]
When physical or magic damage is taken.

[Activation Rate]
M+
Activation rate scales with the number of Light elemental Helm/Hat/Armor/Clothing type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of XL (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 3).
